title: Page
description: A routed page in a feature's feature-shell library (features/<scope>/<name>/feature-shell), with its route added to lib.routes.ts and the page title and meta description set with pageMeta.

name.description: The feature the page belongs to, plural: classes, characters.

type.description: The kind of page. view-all, view, create and edit need the feature's API pieces (models and data-access generated with api).

items.label: view-all: the list, a server-paged table (path '')
view: one entity from route resources (path ':id', or ':source/:slug' for a catalog entity)
create: a JSON body form, login required (path 'create'); needs a store with writes
edit: a JSON body form from route resources, login required (path ':id/edit'); needs a store with writes

page.description: A blank page's name: builder, sheet. Required for --type blank.

path.description: The route path under the feature, instead of the type's default.

catalog.description: The feature is a dnd catalog entity (generated with --catalog): view and edit live at :source/:slug, and view-all gets the source and edition columns.

singular.description: The entity's singular when the plural's ending doesn't give it (species, people).
